note: Official questions mapped to FM Chapter 8 (Dividend Decision). Primary code first. RTP assignment follows ICAI's own topic labels ('Dividend Decision', 'Dividend Decisions'); past papers and MTPs follow the theory the question applies. Note two placements worth stating: Lintner's Model sits in SM §7 (Practical Considerations — Payout policies), not in §8, so MTP-S24-S1-FQ3b carries primary code F08.07; and questions that value a share from dividends and a growth rate are treated as Gordon / the Dividend Discount Model under F08.10, the same formula Chapter 4 §7.3 uses to find Ke rather than price. Case-scenario MCQ sets are recorded as one atom using the first MCQ's id.
